turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Hi there, how are you feeling now after the surgery?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: I'm okay, I guess. Still a bit groggy, but the pain isn't too bad.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Good to hear. Can you tell me your pain level out of 10?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Maybe a 3 or 4? It's more like discomfort than sharp pain.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: That's expected with the TAP block still working. Are you feeling nauseous at all?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, not really. A bit thirsty, but no nausea.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Great. How's your breathing? Any tightness or difficulty breathing?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, I'm breathing fine. Just a bit tired from the anesthesia, I think.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Good. Do you remember anything from the operating room?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Not really. I went to sleep and woke up here, so I think I was out completely.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: That's normal under general anesthesia. Given your diabetes and high blood pressure, we'll keep a close eye on your vitals and sugar levels. Any concerns from your side?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, everything seems fine. Just want to go home and rest.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: We'll get you ready for that soon. Let the nurse know if the pain increases or if you feel unwell in any way.
